Description.value: Repositions/resizes CATUI's rebuilt craftingInfoPanel elements (search tabs, ingredients, stat panel, crafting queue) to fit Project Z's wider layout. Pixel values recovered from the original ZZZ_CATUI_ProjectZ_compatible patch, minus the recipeCraftCountControl-in-preview logic that caused the original NullReferenceException crash (v1.1.0+: the craft-count control is re-homed into itemActions by THIS mod, so Project Z stays stock).
